privacy: Invented hosts only. No live Nexitally URL, account id, or node secret.

cases.title: Managed full profile
cases.notes: Typical Nexitally-shaped download: keep four nodes, drop the duplicate, English/Chinese banners, and [Premium].

cases.title: Managed full profile with UTF-8 BOM + CRLF
cases.notes: Same body after the parser strips a leading BOM and normalizes CRLF.

cases.title: Official seven prefixes
cases.notes: anytls, shadowsocks, vmess, vless, trojan, http, and socks5 from Quantumult X sample.conf.

cases.title: AnyTLS Reality + SS2022
cases.notes: Reality fields are opaque to the parser. A supported prefix is enough.

cases.title: SSR and SS2022 sample lines
cases.notes: Both still start with shadowsocks=.

cases.title: English and Chinese banners
cases.notes: Traffic, Expire, Reset, Days Left, 流量, 到期, 剩余, 套餐.

cases.title: Reset substring trap
cases.notes: HK-Reset-01 and HK-Preset-01 drop because Reset is a substring. HK-RST-01 stays.

cases.title: Days Left spacing
cases.notes: Only the spaced token Days Left is excluded.

cases.title: [Premium] inside a tag
cases.notes: Exclusion regex, not a section cut.

cases.title: [Premium] as the next section
cases.notes: The next [heading] lookahead ends [server_local]. LATE-01 never enters the body.

cases.title: Traffic inside password=
cases.notes: Exclusion tokens are unanchored. A password containing Traffic is dropped.

cases.title: Comments and exact duplicates
cases.notes: ; # // comments drop. Trimmed exact duplicates drop. Leading/trailing spaces are trimmed before keep.

cases.title: Inline hash is not a comment
cases.notes: Comment detection is prefix-only after trim.

cases.title: C-style block comment is not a comment
cases.notes: /* ... */ is an unsupported prefix, not a Quantumult X comment.

cases.title: Mixed-case heading and prefixes
cases.notes: [Server_Local] and AnyTLS= are accepted. Original spelling is preserved.

cases.title: Indented heading and tabbed line
cases.notes: Optional whitespace is allowed before [server_local] and before a server line.

cases.title: [server_local] is the last section
cases.notes: The section regex can terminate at end of file.

cases.title: First of two [server_local] sections
cases.notes: String.match is not global. SECOND-01 is ignored.

cases.title: No leak from other sections
cases.notes: Server-shaped lines in [policy], [filter_local], and [server_remote] stay out.

cases.title: Whitespace before =
cases.notes: The supported prefix regex allows spaces before the equals sign.

cases.title: http= vs https= / socks vs socks5 / ss vs shadowsocks
cases.notes: https=, socks=, and ss= are unsupported prefixes.

cases.title: IPv6 hosts and CJK tags
cases.notes: 香港/日本/新加坡 stay. 剩余-01 drops because 剩余 is an exclusion token.

cases.title: Same host, different tag
cases.notes: Dedup compares the whole trimmed line.
